content.title: About - Virginia Commonwealth University
content.text: Home About Unlike any university you’ve ever seen At Virginia Commonwealth University, we’re not interested in outdated traditions. We’re too focused on what’s next. Our community is more than 300,000 strong — each Ram a unique mix of style, story and attitude. Ignited by the energy of the city, we’re ready to lead industries — or disrupt them. Here, artists and engineers, doctors and designers are coming together to reimagine the human experience and tackle the problems of tomorrow. Together, we’re forging a future that is built by us. 8 things that make us #RamProud Richmond A dynamic urban center of culture and creativity — just like us. Research The National Science Foundation ranks us among the top 50 public U.S. schools. Community engagement It’s a major part of the VCU experience. More than 8,500 students participated in community/civically engaged learning courses in 2024-25. 23 in the top 50 U.S. News and World Report ranks 23 of our programs and graduate schools in their top 50. Belonging Everyone is welcome here. We love that our students come from all different backgrounds and show up as they are. Their collective energy powers our progress. Health sciences VCU is the only Virginia school to offer degrees in dentistry, health professions, medicine, nursing, pharmacy and public health. #1 hospital VCU Medical Center is the top hospital in the Richmond region and one of the best in Virginia. Peppas We have one of the most celebrated pep bands in the country. A creative culture fueled by unexpected collaborations We’re a top 50 public research university and we’re home to one of the top-ranked public graduate arts schools. What does that mean for you? Research and innovation are our greatest strengths and they will be part of your VCU education, no matter what field you pursue. So, bring us your curious minds and your boldest ideas — there’s nothing common happening here. Explore VCU Health That’s our medical enterprise, where our experts teach and mentor future doctors and other health professionals, provide great care to patients and conduct trailblazing medical research. As a VCU student, you’ll have the chance to pursue a health career, connect a health-related topic to your studies or even volunteer to make a patient’s day brighter. Learn more about VCU Health.
